links.outcome: Sensitivity of predicted breast cancer risk to simulated image alterations (translation, rotation, cropping, pectoral removal)
links.effect: Model sensitive to translation, rotation, registration, cropping (LOA up to ±0.1); complete pectoral removal caused bias (1-yr LOA [-0.07, 0.04]); AUC unchanged (1-yr 0.90, 5-yr 0.77); left-right swap no impact.
links.quote: The model was sensitive to translation, rotation, registration, and cropping, where LOAs of up to ±0.1 were observed.

screen.reason: The study conducts a sensitivity and robustness analysis of the MIRAI breast cancer risk model against realistic image positioning and acquisition variations, evaluating individual prediction stability.
